content:
The weekly roundup is back, checking in on what's new this week at the Apple Certified Refurbished store. Highlights include the MacBook Neo, new MacBook Air configurations, and the Apple Watch Ultra 3.

The Apple Certified Refurbished store is a great way to buy directly from Apple's website, with savings of up to 15%.

Here's what you need to know:

  • Excellent quality, attractive prices
  • Undergo a strict refurbishment process before being sold
  • Backed by Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple's 14-day return policy
  • Optional AppleCare product protection plans available
  • Engraving and gift wrapping are not available for refurbished products

We track every new addition and price drop at the Apple Certified Refurbished store so you don't have to. Inventory changes quickly, and this guide is meant to give you a snapshot of what's currently available before it sells out.

Macs

For me, the MacBook Neo and MacBook Air pricing stand out as the best deals this round. Both are ideal for anyone entering the Apple ecosystem for the first time or upgrading to Apple Silicon.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo with 256GB storage: $599 (originally $799 new)
  • MacBook Neo with 512GB storage and Touch ID: $679 (originally $799 new)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,099 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 1TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,529 (originally $1,799 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 2TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,949 (originally $2,299 new)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 256GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,269 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,439 (originally $1,699 new)

Studio Display

We reported a few weeks ago that the refurbished store already had the Studio Display XDR listed. As always, inventory moves fast, and the Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, two configurations remain in stock:

  • Studio Display XDR with standard glass and a tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $2,799 (originally $3,299 new)
  • Studio Display XDR with nano-texture glass and a tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $3,059 (originally $3,599 new)

Apple TV 4K

The basic Apple TV 4K, which has been hard to come by, is back in stock this week, while the higher-end Ethernet-equipped model, which has been around longer, is also available. The basic version typically sells out quickly — act fast if you're interested.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 64GB storage, Wi-Fi: $169 (originally $199 new)
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 128GB storage, Wi-Fi, and Ethernet: $209 (originally $249 new)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear the Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day, and if you've been looking to join me, the refurbished store has some compelling deals this week:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm black titanium case with black Ocean band: $679 (originally $799 new)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm natural titanium case with Anchor Blue Ocean band: $679 (originally $799 new)

As always, head over to 9to5Toys to keep up with all the week's best Apple deals.
